name: @weyos/mobile
$comment: Sensor dependencies are deliberately NOT installed yet. Add them one at a time, each with a dev build that proves it works on a physical device: react-native-health / expo-health-connect (VEY-SENSOR-1), react-native-ble-plx (VEY-SENSOR-2), expo-background-fetch + expo-task-manager (VEY-SENSOR-3). Installing all three at once turns a first failed build into a four-way guess.
